question: V100 attention kernel memory bound to compute bound transition batch size

sources.title: GitHub - ArjunSom9/VoltaFlash: CUDA Kernel using Flash Attention for ...
sources.snippet: 2.2. Memory Hierarchy and Ridge Point ... The Mathematical Ridge Point for the V100 is calculated at ~138.8 FLOPs/byte. Any kernel with an arithmetic intensity below this is memory-bound; our goal is to exceed this point to become compute-bound.
